entries.toelichting: Root glh. Make uncovered, reveal, lead into exile (uncovering of land). 'Uncover' preserves the kernel-uncovering-action across all fields.
Aramaic cognate of H1540 galah with double-meaning: reveal (Dan 2:19,22,28-30,47) and lead-into-exile (Ezra 4:10, 5:12); Aramaic context of Ezra-Daniel uses both aspects.

Josh-Arab-and-Dumah-and-Eshan-Janim-and-Beth-Tappuah-and-Aphekah-Humtah-and-Kiriath-Arba-Hebron-and-Zior-nine-cities-with-villages-Maon-Carmel-and-Ziph-and-Juttah-Jezreel-and-Jokdeam-and-Zanoah-Cain-Gibeah (Josh 15:51; 2Sam 15:12). Hyphenated.
Round-bowl on lampstand or pillar (2Chr 4:12,13; 1Kgs 7:41,42; Zech 4:2,3; Eccl 12:6). Hyphenated to distinguish bowl-globe-aspect from H4219 mizraq 'sprinkling-bowl' and H3713 kefor 'basin'.
Pejorative term for idol-images, root √galal (roll/dung); the hyphenated English preserves the contemptuous load.
Wrap-mantles of blue and embroidered; Eze 27:24.
From √galah (uncover, carry-away); deportation into captivity (Babylon); concordantly 'exile'.
Zerubbabel-with-return-from-exile and Daniel-with-deported-of-Judah (Ezra 6:16; Dan 2:25; 5:13; 6:14). Hyphenated to distinguish exile-deportees-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew galut.
Piel: shave off hair (nazirite, leper, priest); concordantly 'shave'.
Mirror or polishing wax-tablet - in Isaiah 3:23 (the mirrors and the fine linen and the hoods) and Isaiah 8:1 (take a great roll and write on it with a man's pen); shining-polished surface.
1K-the-two-doors-had-rolling-pivots and Song-his-hands-are-as-gold-rings-set-with-beryl (1K 6:34; Song 5:14 cf). Hyphenated.

District or circle-region (especially 'district of the gentiles' > later Galilee) - in Isaiah 8:23 (the district of the gentiles, Galil ha-goyim) and Joel 3:4 (all you districts of Palestina); extension of H1550a.
Northern hill-region of Israel (Josh 20:7; 21:32; 1Kgs 9:11; 2Kgs 15:29; 1Chr 6:76; Isa 8:23). English convention: Galilee.
Border-district or surrounding region (Josh 13:2; 18:17; 22:10,11; Eze 47:8; Joel 3:4). Hyphenated to preserve district-encircled-aspect; family with H1556 galal.
Proper noun ('circuits') Benjamin-border-place; Josh 18:17; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Geliloth.
1S-Saul-had-given-Michal-his-daughter-David's-wife-to-Phalti-the-son-of-Laish-of-Gallim and Isa-lift-up-your-voice-daughter-Gallim (1S 25:44; Isa 10:30). Hyphenated.
Philistine giant defeated by David (1Sam 17:4,23; 21:10; 22:10; 2Sam 21:19; 1Chr 20:5). English convention: Goliath.
Qal: roll (away) stone/load; concordantly 'roll'.
Prophecy: Jeroboam's-house swept-away as dung; 1Kgs 14:10.
From √galal (roll, H1556); 'on-grounds-of' as prepositional-dependent-object, always in 'bi-galal' = 'because-of' (Gen 12:13, 30:27, 39:5).
Galal-Levite-temple-singer-post-exile-Jerusalem and Galal-twice-in-Levite-registers (1Chr 9:15,16; Neh 11:17). English convention: Galal. 'Rolled-roller' or 'beneficent' (family with galal-roll).
Large hewn block-stones with which the walls of the second temple were built - Ezra 5:8, 6:4; Aramaic, related to rolling-turning because of size.
Image of transience and humiliation (Job 20:7; 1Kgs 14:10; Zeph 1:17; Eze 4:12,15). Hyphenated to distinguish dung-refuse-aspect from H1828 domen 'dung-heap' (already assigned) and H6569 peresh.
Proper noun, Levi-singer wall-dedication-procession; Neh 12:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gilalai.
Qal; Elijah folded his mantle to strike Jordan; 2Kgs 2:8.
Your-eyes saw my-unformed-substance; Ps 139:16. NL refined audit-2026-04-26: root g-l-m fold-roll; embryo was modern medical import.
Job-barren-not-bearing and Isa-you-were-childless-forsaken and Ps-barren-lonely (Job 3:7; 15:34; 30:3; Isa 49:21). Hyphenated.
Prov-before-fool-breaks-out-strife and Prov-wise-restrains-sudden-anger and Prov-strife-breaks-through-as-water (Prov 17:14; 18:1; 20:3). Hyphenated.
Gen-Laban-called-it-Jegar-sahadutha-Jacob-called-it-Galeed and Gen-therefore-the-name-of-it-was-called-Galeed-and-Mizpah (Gen 31:47,48). Hyphenated.
Proper noun (region). English convention Gilead.
Ethnonym-adjective of Gilead (H1568) for inhabitant or descendant; Jephthah's origin (Judg 10:3 Jair, 11:1,40, 12:4,5,7), Barzillai's loyalty (2Sam 17:27, 19:32, 1Kgs 2:7).

Cascade or flow down as hair from a mountain-side - in Song of Songs 4:1 (your hair is as a flock of goats descending from mount Gilead) and Song 6:5 (your hair is as a flock of goats appearing from Gilead).
Additive particle. 'Also' covers the additive function.
Gen-let-me-sip-a-little-water-from-your-pitcher and Job-he-swallows-the-ground-and-snorts-with-rage (Gen 24:17; Job 39:24). Hyphenated.
Nile-papyrus for basket-weaving (Ex 2:3; Job 8:11; Isa 18:2; 35:7). Hyphenated to distinguish papyrus-rush-aspect from H7070 qaneh 'reed' and H100 agmon 'rush-reed' (already assigned).
Short measure (about a cubit) Ehud-sword; Judg 3:16.
Proper noun, watcher-people on Tyre-towers; Eze 27:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gammadite.
From √gamal (recompense); deserved reward or punishment; concordantly 'recompense'.
Proper noun, twenty-second priest-lot David's-time; 1Chr 24:17; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gamul.
Barzillai-David-recompense-decline and peoples-vengeance-recompense (2Sam 19:37; Isa 59:18; Jer 51:56; Ps 94:2). Hyphenated to distinguish recompense-reward-aspect from H1576 gemul.
Proper noun, place taken by Philistines under Ahaz; 2Chr 28:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gimzo.
Qal: pay back (good or evil), bring to maturity; concordantly 'recompense'.
Camel (animal); concordantly 'camel'.
Proper noun, father of Ammiel-spy of Dan; Num 13:12; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gemalli.
Manassite tribe-head at Sinai-numbering (Num 1:10; 2:20; 7:54,59; 10:23). English convention: Gamaliel. 'Recompense-of-God'.
God complete-perfect for righteous (Ps 7:10; 12:2; 57:3; 138:8). Hyphenated to distinguish complete-perfect-aspect from H3615 kalah 'finish' (already assigned) and H8552 tamam 'finish'.
Aramaic Pael-passive; perfect-peace-subject; Ezra 7:12.
People-son of Japheth and Hosea's wife (Gen 10:2,3; 1Chr 1:5,6; Eze 38:6; Hos 1:3). English convention: Gomer.
Two pious men in Jeremiah's time (Jer 29:3; 36:10,11,12,25). English convention: Gemariah. 'YHWH-has-completed'.
Enclosed garden; cultural-space against wilderness; concordantly 'garden'.
Qal: secretly take away; distinguished from gazal (violently rob); concordantly 'steal'.
From √ganav (steal); doer of theft; concordantly 'thief'.
Ex-found-living-in-his-hand-the-theft and Ex-shall-restore-double (Ex 22:2,3). Hyphenated to distinguish theft-stolen-goods-aspect from H1589 ganav 'steal' (already assigned).
1K-the-sister-of-Tahpenes-bore-him-his-son-Genubath and 1K-Genubath-was-in-the-house-of-Pharaoh-among-the-sons-of-Pharaoh (1K 11:20 cf; 11:20). Hyphenated.
Female parallel-form of gan (garden, H1588); planted-enclosed-garden with specific-ornamental-plants distinguished from common-garden (Isa 1:29-30, 65:3, 66:17; Song 6:11).
Tibni's father at Israel-division and Levite family-head (1Kgs 16:21,22; Neh 12:4,16). English convention: Ginnath. 'Garden-grove'.
Esther's-royal-treasure and Mordecai-crown-property-Persian-royal-treasury and Eze-precious-chests-of-trade-goods (Esth 3:9; 4:7; Eze 27:24). Hyphenated.
King-decree-search-in-treasury and royal-treasury-of-Babel (Ezra 5:17; 6:1; 7:20). Hyphenated to distinguish treasury-storehouse-royal-treasure-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew genez.
Storerooms temple-blueprint David to Solomon; 1Chr 28:11.

As protective-shield over something-or-someone stand (2Kgs 19:34; 20:6; Isa 31:5; 37:35; 38:6; Zech 9:15; 12:8). Hyphenated; distinguishes protect-roof-action from H1588 gan 'garden' (enclosed space).
Ginnethon-priestly-family-returnee-Zerubbabel and Ginnethon-sealer-covenant-renewal-Nehemiah (Neh 10:7; 12:4,16). English convention: Ginnethon. 'Garden-like-garden-hortus' (family with H1588 gan).
1S-the-cows-went-straight-on-the-way-to-Beth-shemesh-lowing-as-they-went and Job-does-the-wild-ass-bray-over-his-grass-or-the-ox-low-over-his-fodder (1S 6:12; Job 6:5). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, border-place Jerusalem-extension; Jer 31:39; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Goah.
Inwardly turn-away from someone or something; God of his people (Lev 26:11,15,30,43,44; Eze 16:45). Hyphenated to preserve deep-aversion-reaction; distinguishes from H8581 ta'av and homonym H1351.
Ephraimite rebel son-of-Eved - led-revolt against-Abimelech (Judg 9:26-41 core-account); concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gaal.
Israel-at-birth-despised and loathed; Eze 16:5.
Qal: authoritatively reprimand, threaten (YHWH rebukes the sea, Satan); concordantly 'rebuke'.
From √gaar (rebuke); angry forbidding-utterance (YHWH rebukes waves, enemies); the hyphenated English marks voice-elevation.
Quaking of earth or commotion of sea (2Sam 22:8; Ps 18:8; Jer 5:22; 25:16; 46:7,8; Job 34:20). Hyphenated to preserve commotion-surge.
Gaash-mountain where Joshua-buried-is and David's-warrior (Josh 24:30; Judg 2:9; 2Sam 23:30; 1Chr 11:32). English convention: Gaash. 'Quaking' or 'shaking' (family with ga'ash-shake-tremble).
Gatam-Edomite-prince-son-of-Eliphaz (Gen 36:11,16; 1Chr 1:36). English convention: Gatam. Etymology-unknown.
Own-person as independent unit (Ex 21:3,4; Job 20:22; Prov 9:3; 1Kgs 14:5). Hyphenated to distinguish alone-self-aspect from H905 bad 'alone' and H909 badad 'separately'.
Dan-aramaic-lion-had-eagle's-wings and Dan-aramaic-wings-plucked-out and Dan-aramaic-four-wings-of-bird (Dan 7:4 twice, 7:6). Hyphenated to distinguish wing-aramaic-aspect from H3671 kanaf-Hebrew.
Grape-vine; concordantly 'vine'.
Wood-species for ark-construction; Gen 6:14.
Combustible sulphur-stone, instrument of judgment (Gen 19:24; Deut 29:22; Job 18:15; Ps 11:6; Isa 30:33; 34:9; Eze 38:22). Natural mineral; concordantly preserved untranslated.
Altar-stones ground-to-chalk; Isa 27:9.
Root gwr (sojourn-as-stranger, H1481a). 'Sojourner' preserves the non-native status.
Benjamite family-name; connected to Ehud and Shimei (Gen 46:21; Judg 3:15; 2Sam 16:5; 19:16,18; 1Kgs 2:8; 1Chr 8:3,5,7). English convention: Gera.
Unclean-scabby-skin-disease for offering-disqualifying and judgment-scab-plague (Lev 21:20; 22:22; Deut 28:27). Hyphenated to distinguish scab-itch-skin-disease-aspect from H7822 shechin.
Gareb-Ithrite-one-of-David's-thirty and hill-Gareb-near-Jerusalem (2Sam 23:38; 1Chr 11:40; Jer 31:39). English convention: Gareb. 'Leprous-scratch' or 'scab-spot' (family with H1618 garav).
Two-three-olives-remain hanging after-harvest; Isa 17:6.
Throat-place for words and neck-ornament (Prov 1:9; 3:3,22; 6:21). Hyphenated to distinguish throat-neck-gullet-aspect from H1627 garon 'throat-gullet' (already assigned) and H6677 tsavvar 'neck'.
One of the seven Canaanite peoples (Gen 10:16; 15:21; Deut 7:1; Josh 3:10; 24:11; 1Chr 1:14; Neh 9:8). English convention: Girgashite.
Hithpael; Job scraped himself with potsherd on ash; Job 2:8.
Hithpael: meddle in strife, provoke (seek war); the hyphenated English marks confrontation.
Lump-of-food which ruminants from fore-stomach bring-back-up; only in idiom 'bring-up-of-gerah' = chew-cud as clean-animal-mark (Lev 11:3-7,26 camel-hare-coney-pig-classification, Deut 14:6-8).
Smallest silver-weight-unit twentieth-of-shekel (Ex 30:13; Lev 27:25; Num 3:47; 18:16; Eze 45:12). Hyphenated to preserve smallest-weighing-unit.

Throat-organ as source of voice or swallow-passage (Ps 5:10; 69:4; 115:7; 149:6; Prov 3:3; Isa 3:16; 58:1; Jer 2:25; Eze 16:11). Hyphenated to preserve anatomical precision (no H3956 lashon 'tongue').
People-rested in temporary-sojourn near Bethlehem; Jer 41:17.
Niphal; David-says-I-am-cut-off-from-Your-eyes; Ps 31:22.
Blessing-mountain opposite Ebal in Samaria (Deut 11:29; 27:12; Josh 8:33; Judg 9:7). English convention: Gerizim. 'Hewn-mountain-pieces'.
Wood-axe for tree-felling or building-tool (Deut 19:5 twice; 20:19; 1Kgs 6:7; Isa 10:15). Hyphenated to distinguish axe-cutting-iron-aspect from H4621 ma'atsad 'hand-axe' and H7049 qela.
Hapax-form; man-greatest-angry-pays-fine; Prov 19:19.
First-sense garam; judges-not-bones-gnaw-till-morning; Zeph 3:3.
Num-gnaw-bones-Moab and Eze-men-of-war-daughter-of-judge-his-bones-gnaw (Num 24:8; Eze 23:34). Hyphenated to distinguish break-gnaw-bones-aspect from H1633a garam.
Bone-skeleton of body or object (Gen 49:14; 2Kgs 9:13; Job 40:18; Ps 53:6; Prov 17:22; 25:15). Hyphenated to distinguish bone-skeleton-aspect from H1472 geviyah 'corpse-body' and H6106 etsem.
Aramaic parallel; lions-crush-bones-of-men; Dan 6:24.
Patronym-clan Keilah-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Garmite.
Flat open place where grain is threshed and winnowed; concordantly 'threshing-floor'.

The crushing or grinding - Psalm 119:20 (my soul breaks for the longing it has unto Your judgments at all times) and Lamentations 3:16 (He has also broken my teeth with gravel-stones, He has covered me with ashes).
Qal: take away, withhold, shorten; concordantly 'diminish'.
Qal; Kishon-brook swept-away enemies; Judg 5:21.
Chewing the cud as clean-mark of animal (Lev 11:7; Deut 14:7,8; 1Kgs 14:11; Hab 1:15). Hyphenated to distinguish chew-cud-aspect from homonym H1641a garar-I 'drag' and H4573 ma'ar.

Philistine city-state southwest of Israel under king Abimelech; Abraham's temporary-residence (Gen 20:1-2,18 Sarah-as-sister), Isaac's-well-controversies (Gen 26:1-26 well-repetition, blessing-strife), Asa's victory.
Lev-if-offering-firstfruits-grain-offering-LORD-shall-you-ears-roasted-by-fire-groats-of-fresh-corn-offer and Lev-and-as-groats-at-house-thresholds (Lev 2:14,16). Hyphenated.
Qal/Piel: chase away, expel; concordantly 'drive-out'.
What the sun drives forth out of the earth; Deut 33:14.
Princes-stop-expulsion-injustice against people; Eze 45:9.
Firstborn son of Moses by Zipporah (Ex 2:22, 18:3); 'sojourner-there'; Levitical main-line (1Chr 6:16-17, 23:15-16, 26:24); also Ezra-contemporary (Ezra 8:2); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('exiled-one'); eldest son of Levi; concordantly transliterated.
Patronymic 'Gershonites'; Levitical-clan of Gershon (Num 3, 4, 26, 1Chr 6); concordantly transliterated.
Aramean-kingdom east-of-Sea-of-Galilee - father-in-law-territory of-David (Deut 3:14, 2Sam 3:3 Maacah-mother-of-Absalom, 13:37-38, 14:23,32, 15:8). English convention: Geshur.
Gentilic of Geshur, Aramean neighbour-people (Deut 3:14; Josh 12:5; 13:2,11,13; 1Sam 27:8). English convention: Geshurite.
Hapax Jer 14:22 heavens-give-rain; from H1653 geshem rain.
Heavy rainfall, in dry season malign; distinguished from matar (ordinary rain); concordantly 'downpour'.
Arabian-opponent of Nehemiah at wall-rebuilding (Neh 2:19; 6:1,2,6). English convention: Geshem. Distinguished from homonym H1653 geshem 'rain' (already assigned).
Aramaic-equivalent for fleshly-body in Daniel (Dan 3:27,28; 4:30; 5:21; 7:11). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H1653 geshem 'rain'.
Zion's-land not-watered on-day-of-wrath; Eze 22:24.
Proper noun; eastern Nile-delta where Israel dwelt, and a city in Judah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Nethinim-overseer alongside Ziha; Neh 11:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Gispa.
Piel; feel-out-before-self as blind; Isa 59:10.
Press-vat in which grapes are trodden (Judg 6:11; Neh 13:15; Isa 63:2; Lam 1:15; Joel 3:13). Hyphenated to distinguish winepress-treading-aspect from H3342 yeqev 'winepress' and H6333 purah.
Proper noun ('winepress'); Philistine capital; concordantly transliterated.

Josh-the-border-went-from-thence-eastward-toward-the-rising-of-the-sun-to-Gath-Hepher and 2K-according-to-the-word-of-the-LORD-which-He-spoke-by-the-hand-of-His-servant-Jonah-son-of-Amittai-prophet-from-Gath-Hepher (Josh 19:13; 2K 14:25). Hyphenated.

Gentilic-inhabitant of-Gath - used-for Philistine-inhabitants and-for David's-elite-loyal-servants from-Gath (Josh 13:3, 2Sam 6:10-11 = 1Chr 13:13 Obed-Edom-the-Gittite, 2Sam 15:18-22 Ittai-the-Gittite).
2S-the-Beerothites-fled-to-Gittaim-and-have-been-sojourners-there and Neh-in-Hadid-Zeboim-Neballat-Lod-and-Ono-in-the-valley-of-craftsmen (2S 4:3; Neh 11:33). Hyphenated.
Psalms-title-designation (Ps 8:1, 81:1, 84:1); possibly from Gath-instrument H1661 or winepress.
Gen-sons-Aram-Uz-Hul-Gether-Mash and 1Chr-sons-Aram-Gether (Gen 10:23; 1Chr 1:17). Hyphenated to distinguish Gether-son-Aram-Aramean-tribe-aspect from other Aramean-eponyms; Semitic-tribe-eponym.
Dan-Levitical-city and Manasseh-city (Josh 19:45; 21:24,25; 1Chr 6:54,69). Compound 'press-of-pomegranate'.
Aramaic-demonstrative in feminine form (Ezra 5:9; Dan 4:27; 5:6; 7:3,8). Hyphenated to mark feminine-parallel of H1836 denah 'this-aramaic' (masc.).
Ps-my-eyes-pine-from-tears and Jer-soul-faint-with-sorrow and Ps-die-with-soul-pining (Ps 88:10; Jer 31:12,25). Hyphenated to distinguish languish-pine-grieve-faint-aspect.
Before-him-flees-fear-and-languishing; Job 41:22.
Soul-wasting-grieving in foreign land; Deut 28:65.
Inward concern or fear cherish about outcome (1Sam 9:5; 10:2; Ps 38:19; Isa 57:11; Jer 17:8; 38:19; 42:16). Hyphenated to distinguish anxiety-worry from H3025 yagor 'fear' (acute).
Edomite, chief-shepherd of Saul; Nob-slaughterer (1Sam 21:8; 22:9,18,22; Ps 52:2). English convention: Doeg.
Inward-worry that depresses the heart (Josh 22:24; Jer 49:23; Eze 4:16; 12:18,19; Prov 12:25). Hyphenated to distinguish brooding-fear-aspect from H6343 pachad 'fear' and H2731 charadah 'trembling'.
Bird-of-prey-swoop as speed-image (Deut 28:49; Jer 48:40; 49:22; Ps 18:11). Hyphenated to distinguish swoop-fly-aspect from H5774 uf 'fly' and H8582 ta'ah 'wander'; family with H1676.
Unclean bird-of-prey-species; Lev 11:14.

Syrian-brown-bear as predator; David's lion-and-bear-experience (1Sam 17:34-37), comparison-courage (2Sam 17:8 'bear bereaved of cubs'), Elisha's two she-bears (2Kgs 2:24), wisdom-paradigm (Prov 17:12).
Aramaic parallel; second-beast-as-bear; Dan 7:5.
Hapax of uncertain core meaning; 'as-your-days-your-dove'; Deut 33:25.
Qal-participle; wine-stream-makes-sleeper-soft-speak; Song 7:9.

Evil-slander-or-defaming-rumour distinguished from lashon-ra (evil-tongue) and rakil (slanderer) by rumour-character (Gen 37:2 Joseph 'brought their evil-report to-their-father', Num 13:32, 14:36-37, Ps 31:14, Prov 10:18, 25:10, Jer 20:10, Eze 36:3).
Wild-bee-swarm as war-image or destructive (Deut 1:44; Judg 14:8; Ps 118:12; Isa 7:18). Hyphenated to distinguish bee-swarm-aspect from homonym H1683 Deborah-person and H1706 devash 'honey'.
Rebekah's-nurse who was buried under 'Lament-oak' near Bethel (Gen 35:8); female-prophetess-judge who Sisera-defeat-orchestrated and triumph-song-sang (Judg 4:4,5,6,9,10,14, 5:1,7,12,15).
Aramaic Pael-participle; Jews offered in temple; Ezra 6:3.
Aramaic noun 'place-of-sacrifices'; Ezra 6:3.
Four-shekels price in famine Samaria; 2Kgs 6:25.
Holy of holies in temple, innermost chamber; the hyphenated English marks position (distinguished from Debir pn).
Most-holy back chamber of temple (where Ark stood); the hyphenated English distinguishes from Devir II pn.
Second-sense Debir; Gad-border-place; Josh 13:26; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('fig-cake') north-border-destruction; Eze 6:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Diblah.
Pressed-dried-fig-disc as provision (1Sam 25:18; 30:12; 1Chr 12:41; Isa 38:21). Hyphenated to preserve pressed-fig-disc-aspect.
Father of Gomer-Hosea-wife (Hos 1:3); proper noun, plural-form fig-cake.
Qal: attach oneself to, follow; concordantly 'cleave' (also marriage-context Gen 2:24).
Aramaic cling-fast (Dan 2:43 not-cling-to-each-other); cognate Hebrew H1692 davaq.
Ahab-arrow-between-joints-of-armour and Isaiah-smith-soldering-joints (1Kgs 22:34; 2Chr 18:33; Isa 41:7). Hyphenated to distinguish joint-seam-cleaved-parts-aspect from H1695 daveq.
Adherents-clinging-to-YHWH and king-armour-clinging (Deut 4:4; 1Chr 10:6; 2Chr 3:12). Hyphenated to distinguish cleaving-clinging-loyal-aspect from H539 aman 'faithful'.
Root dbr. Piel-directed communication-activity. 'Speak' is the kernel-activity; davar (H1697) is the result.
Root dbr (speak, H1696). Davar is the spoken thing; encompasses 'matter' because matters in Hebrew are spoken-things.
Contagious deadly disease (plague); concordantly 'pestilence' (not 'plague' alone - broader).

Grassy pasture or grazing-area - in Isaiah 5:17 (the lambs shall feed after their manner, and the strangers shall eat the waste places of the fat ones) and Micah 2:12 (I will surely assemble them as the sheep of Bozrah).
Second-sense dibber; prophets-empty word; Jer 5:13.
The matter or cause concerning which something is spoken - Psalm 110:4 (you are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek), Eccl 3:18, 7:14, 8:2, Job 5:8; variant-form of H1697 davar.
Aramaic parallel; that-the-living-may-know; Dan 4:17.
Divine-decree; Deut 33:3.
Proper noun, Danite-father of Shelomith; Lev 24:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dibri.
Daberath-city in Issachar-Zebulon-border and Levite-city (Josh 19:12; 21:28; 1Chr 6:57). English convention: Daberath. 'Pasture-place' (family with H1699 dover-pasture).
Honey from bees and grape-syrup; concordantly 'honey'.
Treasures on camel-humps to Egypt; Isa 30:6.
Proper noun, Zebulon-border-place; Josh 19:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dabbesheth.
Scaly sea-creature, created on day 5; concordantly 'fish'.
Collective: fish as species (more than just animal); the hyphenated English distinguishes from dag 'fish'.
Qal; numerous-multiply-as-fish; Gen 48:16.
Proper noun; Philistine deity (fish/grain-god), temple in Gaza/Ashdod; concordantly transliterated.
First-sense dagul; bridegroom distinguished-among-ten-thousands; Song 5:10.
Song-beloved-distinguished-among-ten-thousand-banner-bearer and Ps-under-God-banners-set-up (Song 5:10; 6:4,10; Ps 20:6). Hyphenated.
Army-banner of a tribe in wilderness-camp (Num 2); the hyphenated English marks function.
General term for grain (wheat, barley); concordantly 'corn' (distinguished from chittah wheat).
Brood or hatch eggs - in Isaiah 34:15 (there shall the wild owl make her nest and lay and hatch) and Jeremiah 17:11 (as the partridge gathers eggs which she has not laid).
Suckling-breast as love-image in Proverbs and prophets (Prov 5:19; Eze 23:3,8,21). Hyphenated to distinguish breast-suckling-aspect from H7699 shad 'mother-breast' (already assigned) and H2306 chad.
Walk solemnly or go slowly forward in procession - in Psalm 42:5 (I went with them solemnly to the house of God) and Isaiah 38:15 (I shall walk softly all my years for the bitterness of my soul).
Grandson of Cush (Gen 10:7, 1Chr 1:9) and son of Jokshan of Keturah (Gen 25:3, 1Chr 1:32); became Arabian trade-people associated with Tema (Jer 25:23, 49:8 'dwell deep', Eze 25:13 'from Teman').
Second-sense Dedan; Edomite-trade-people Tyre; Eze 27:15; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Arabian caravans lodging in thickets; Isa 21:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dedanites.
Gen-sons-of-Javan-Elishah-Tarshish-Kittim-and-Dodanim and 1Chr-sons-Javan-Elishah-Tarshish-Kittim-Rodanim (Gen 10:4; 1Chr 1:7). Hyphenated.
Aramaic noun: gold; parallel to Hebrew zahav; concordantly compound with language-marker.
Aramaic gentilic exiles-people (Ezra 4:9); identity uncertain, possibly Daha-tribe.
Hapax Jer 14:9 Yah-as-astonished-man; root √dhm bewilderment.
Qal-participle; galloping-horses against Nineveh; Nah 3:2.
Judg-then-the-horse-hooves-stamped-by-the-galloping-the-galloping-of-their-mighty-ones and Nah-the-leaping-of-horses-and-the-jumping-of-chariots (Judg 5:22; Nah 3:2 cf). Hyphenated.
Hiphil; soul-wasting-cause; Lev 26:16.
Fisher or catcher - in Ezekiel 47:10 (the fishers shall stand upon it) and Jeremiah 16:16 (I will send for many fishers, says the LORD, and they shall fish them); near-variant of H1770 dug.
Fish-hooks for last-of-people; Amos 4:2.
Beloved person (uncle, lover, beloved); in Song of Songs the beloved; concordantly 'beloved'.
Large ceramic cooking-pot or basket (1Sam 2:14; 2Chr 35:13; Job 41:12; Ps 81:7; Jer 24:1,2). Hyphenated to mark food-preparation-vessel; distinguished from H5518 sir 'pot-kettle'.
Proper noun. Root dwd (love); meaning 'beloved'. Transliteration standard in English.
Moses-aunt-Jochebed and uncle-sins-punishable (Ex 6:20; Lev 18:14; 20:20). Hyphenated to distinguish aunt-uncle's-wife-aspect from H5360 neqamah 'vengeance' and H1730a dod-I 'uncle-beloved'.
Three different persons: Issacharite judge and David's mighty men (Judg 10:1; 2Sam 23:9,24; 1Chr 11:12,26; 27:4). 'His-beloved'. English convention: Dodo.
Proper noun, father of prophet Eliezer; 2Chr 20:37; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dodavahu.
Mandrake-plant-fruit with folk-belief-aphrodisiac (Gen 30:14,15,16; Song 7:14). Hyphenated to preserve amorous-folklore-load; no reduction to plant-name.
Proper noun, David's-army-commander second month; 1Chr 27:4; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dodai.
Qal; menstrual-uncleanness status; Lev 12:2.
Established-unclean by monthly flow or sickness (Lev 15:33; 20:18; Isa 30:22; Lam 1:13; 5:17). Hyphenated to preserve female-cycle-uncleanness-aspect; family with H1738 davah.
Ritual-filth wash-off or soul-purification (2Chr 4:6; Isa 4:4; Jer 51:34; Eze 40:38). Hyphenated to distinguish cleansing-rinse-aspect from H7857 shataf 'overflow' and H3526 kavas 'wash'.
The exhausting bodily misery - Job 6:7 (my soul refuses to touch what is to me as sorrowful meat) and Psalm 41:4 (on the bed of languishing); from H1738 davah (menstruate-be-sick).
Lam-sick-weakening-heart and Isa-sick-heart and Isa-no-more-sick-shall-I-be-faint (Lam 1:22; 5:17; Isa 1:5; Jer 8:18). Hyphenated to distinguish languishing-weak-aspect.
Qal; manna processing; Num 11:8.
Lev-stork-heron-hoopoe-bat and Deut-heron-hoopoe-bat (Lev 11:19; Deut 14:18). Hyphenated to distinguish hoopoe-cuckoo-unclean-aspect from other birds.

The silence of the realm of the dead where God is not praised - Psalm 94:17 (my soul had almost dwelt in silence) and Psalm 115:17 (the dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence).
Edomite descendant and Arabian region (Gen 25:14; 1Chr 1:30; Josh 15:52; Isa 21:11). English convention: Dumah. 'Silence-stillness'.

The waiting silence before God - Psalm 22:3 (in the night seasons and am not silent), 39:3 (I was dumb with silence), 62:2 (truly my soul waits silently for God) and 65:2 (praise waits for You, O God in Zion).
Isa-they-sit-silently-on-the-ground and Lam-let-him-sit-alone-in-silence and Hab-awaken-stone-in-silence (Isa 47:5; Lam 3:26; Hab 2:19). Hyphenated to distinguish silent-quietly-soundless-aspect.
Melting-wax as image of enemies before God (Ps 22:15; 68:3; 97:5; Mic 1:4). Hyphenated to distinguish wax-beeswax-aspect from H4549 masas 'melt' (already assigned) and H5413 nathakh 'pour-out'.
Qal; fear-leaps-before-Leviathan; Job 41:22.
Qal-infinitive; David prefers temple-doorpost over wicked-tents; Ps 84:10.
Aramaic Peal: inhabit/dwell as permanent dwelling-place (Dan 2:38, 3:31, 4:9,18,32,35, 5:19, 6:25). Concordantly via '-aramaic'.
Ball or globe-shaped object - in Isaiah 22:18 (He will surely roll you as a ball) and Isaiah 29:3 (I will encamp against you in a circle); concrete-geometric form, related to dur (go around).
Second-sense dur; Shebna-as-ball-hurled into wide land; Isa 22:18.
Unique lexeme. Generation as time-unit and as group of people. 'Generation' covers both under one word.
Phoenician coastal city at Carmel-foot (Josh 11:2; 12:23; 17:11; Judg 1:27; 1Kgs 4:11; 1Chr 7:29). English convention: Dor.
Aramaic-proper-noun plain where Nebuchadnezzar-image stood; Dan 3:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dura.
Qal: tread out grain or process with threshing-sledges, fig. crush enemy; concordantly 'thresh'.
Aramaic Pael; fourth-beast-treads-earth; Dan 7:23.
Qal/Niphal/Pual: vigorous-push-down-or-overthrow distinguished from hadaph (push-away, H1920), nadach (drive-out, H5080), zanach (cast-off, H2186a), nagach (push-with-horns, H5055), and nagaph.
Second-sense dachah; false-prophets-slip in darkness; Jer 23:12.
Aramaic for diversion-entertainment for king not-brought-in; Dan 6:18.
Fall or stumbling - in Psalm 56:14 (that I may walk before God in the light of the living) and Psalm 116:8 (You have delivered my foot from falling); abstract from dacha (push, cause-to-fall).
Aramaic-verb for fear of God or king (Dan 2:31; 4:2; 5:19; 6:27; 7:7,19). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H2342 chul 'tremble'.
Hapax Eze 4:9 bread-mixture-siege-rations; grain-species millet.
Hasty-pressing of royal-messenger and fleeing-people (2Chr 26:20; Esth 3:15; 6:12; 8:14). Hyphenated to distinguish urgent-driving-aspect from H5090a nahag 'drive-on'.

Judg-when-the-LORD-raised-them-up-judges-the-LORD-was-with-the-judge-and-saved-them-out-of-the-hand-of-their-oppressors and Joel-they-shall-each-go-in-his-way-and-they-shall-not-break-their-paths (Judg 2:18; Joel 2:8). Hyphenated.
Measure-noun: what is sufficient, adequate amount; concordantly 'enough'.
Aramaic relative/genitive-marker, counterpart of asher (H834a). In Aramaic text-portions. 'Which' (with (A) marker in entry).
Moabite-Ammonite city east of Dead Sea, rebuilt by Gadites (Num 21:30, 32:3,34 Dibon-Gad, 33:45-46, Josh 13:9,17, Neh 11:25, Isa 15:2,9, Jer 48:18,22); concordantly transliterated.
Piel; God-sends-fishermen to fish-up-people; Jer 16:16.
Fisher as profession - in Isaiah 19:8 (also the fishers shall mourn) and Jeremiah 16:16 (I will send for many fishers, and they shall fish them); from H1770 dug (fish).
Deut-and-the-kite-and-the-vulture-after-his-kind and Isa-also-shall-the-vultures-be-gathered-everyone-with-her-mate (Deut 14:13; Isa 34:15). Hyphenated.
Baruch-wrote-with-ink on scroll; Jer 36:18.
Proper noun ('enough-gold') place Moses-speech; Deut 1:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Di-zahab.
Proper noun Dimon (variant of Dibon) - twice in one verse: Isaiah 15:9 (the waters of Dimon are full of blood, for I will bring more upon Dimon); wordplay with dam (blood) on place-name.
Proper noun, Judah-city south; Josh 15:22; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dimonah.
Qal: settle a legal-case, judge; the hyphenated English marks the juridical action.
The appointing of Aramaic judges who would judge the people - Ezra 7:25 (Ezra appoints judges and law-experts) and Daniel 7:10 (the judgment was set); Aramaic cognate of Hebrew din.
From √din (render-judgment); legal proceeding, judgment; concordantly 'lawsuit'.
Aramaic-equivalent for legal-case or punishment (Ezra 7:26; Dan 4:34; 7:10,22,26). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; family with H1779 din 'lawsuit' (Hebrew).
1S-the-LORD-shall-be-Judge-and-He-shall-judge-between-me-and-you and Ps-a-Father-of-orphans-and-a-Judge-of-widows-is-God-in-the-habitation-of-His-holiness (1S 24:16; Ps 68:6). Hyphenated.
Aramaic for judicial-functionary; Ezra 7:25.
Daughter of Jacob and Leah; central figure in the Shechem-event (Gen 30:21; 34:1,3,5,13,25,26; 46:15). From din 'render-judgment'. As pn-nominal Dinah.
